exercises.name: Squat
exercises.howTo: Feet shoulder-width apart. Sit back and down until your thighs are about level with the floor, chest up, then stand up fully.
exercises.loads: Thighs, hips and spine: the bones that lose the most mass in weightlessness.

exercises.name: Deadlift
exercises.howTo: Soft knees, flat back. Push your hips back and lower your hands close to your legs, then stand up tall by pushing your hips forward.
exercises.loads: Back, hips and hamstrings; loads the lower spine and hip bones.

exercises.name: Heel raise
exercises.howTo: Stand tall with straight knees. Rise onto the balls of your feet, hold for a moment, then lower slowly.
exercises.loads: Calves and ankles; keeps the lower legs strong for walking again after landing.

adjustments.reason: Your temperature is raised. Rest today: hard exercise with a fever strains the heart and slows recovery.
An urgent health alert is open. Rest until the flight surgeon clears you for exercise.
Signs of fatigue, short sleep or a raised resting heart rate: one set fewer of each exercise and longer rests.
Strength is falling or sessions are behind: one more set of squats and deadlifts to load the legs and spine.
